run_pd_control_simulation: run the pybullet pd control simulation with four cartpole robots comparing explicit PD, stable PD, plugin PD, and position control strategies
review_PDControllerExplicitMultiDof_comp: review the PDControllerExplicitMultiDof computePD method that calculates torque for multi-DOF joints using position, velocity, kp, kd, and maxForce arrays
review_PDControllerStable_computePD: review the PDControllerStable computePD method that calculates stable PD control torques for specified joints with target positions and velocities
test_setJointMotorControlMultiDof: test the pybullet setJointMotorControlMultiDof API to apply TORQUE_CONTROL forces to multi-DOF joints on a URDF body
test_setJointMotorControl2_PD_CONTROL: test the pybullet setJointMotorControl2 API with PD_CONTROL mode using positionGain, velocityGain, targetPosition, and targetVelocity parameters
